text: Spotify Technology SA laid off 15 people, approximately 3% of its podcasting team, as the company reorganizes to create fewer layers of management and faster decision-making. As part of the cuts, the Ringer sports program New York, New York with John Jastremski will be canceled, according to a person familiar with the moves who asked to not be identified. “Spotify does not comment on staffing shifts,” a spokesperson for the company said.
